issue.title: Clean up legacy provenance keys on record notes (lid, source_*, recur_id, zorg_id)

task_type_fields.proposal: Decide which legacy provenance frontmatter keys on record notes (eat records' lid and source_*, subscriptions' recur_id, zorg_id) are still needed, then migrate or drop them with a guarded, committed bob operation (dry-run first) and update album legacy declarations, so the record sheet's 'N other properties' fold shrinks to real data.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: plan:202611/record_card.md lists provenance-key cleanup as out of scope; the Record Card only renders those keys read-only in its fold.

issue.creation_reason: The Record Card epic (bob-cli-ms) deferred the provenance-key cleanup and asked its land agent to file it; these keys land in the sheet's other-properties fold.
